tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
RSA launches Agent ID to govern artificial intelligence agents in regulated sectors, with full rollout in 2027. Reported by IT Brief UK.
OpenAI fired three safety researchers, sparking concern over a chilling effect on artificial intelligence safety speech. Reported by Tech Times.
California's 2025–26 education laws introduce artificial intelligence safeguards, device restrictions, and new assessment frameworks for schools. Reported by OCDE Newsroom.
Anthropic launches $100 million FDE training to build artificial intelligence skills across companies. Reported by Business Insider.
OpenAI's 2025 restructuring separates financial ownership from governance, with the foundation holding key control rights. Reported by CEOWORLD magazine.
Free every hour.
